newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 opens up on selective buying, awaits data.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 opens up on selective buying, awaits data.

text.p: The FTSE 100 started the session firmer on Friday as selective buying continued in the face of a big Wall Street drop, dealers said.
"We saw a big buy programme yesterday and the same sort of thing seems to be happening this morning but from a different house," said one.

By 0743 GMT the index was 9.5 points higher at 4,322.7. FTSE futures looked to set to put downward pressure on prices with the June contract, up seven points at 4,330, trailing the cash market. Fair value is seen at around 10 points.
Trade will be light ahead of key U.S. data, dealers said.
